SPIRITS-RAMMED_EARTH.title: Rammed Earth
SPIRITS-RAMMED_EARTH.description: At the start of each combat, begin with 3 Stone Remnants.
SPIRITS-STONE_PACT.title: Stone Pact
SPIRITS-STONE_PACT.description: At the end of your turn, if you have no Stone Remnants, gain 2.
SPIRITS-COLD_ASH.title: Cold Ash
SPIRITS-COLD_ASH.description: Whenever your HP falls below 25%, gain Flash 2.
SPIRITS-SHADOW_IN_MIRROR.title: Shadow in Mirror
SPIRITS-SHADOW_IN_MIRROR.description: Whenever a card is Consumed, gain 5 Block.
SPIRITS-OSCILLATION_CIRCUIT.title: Oscillation Circuit
SPIRITS-OSCILLATION_CIRCUIT.description: After Static Remnants trigger, gain Static Remnants equal to half the trigger value.
SPIRITS-FORMLESS_TWIN_BLADES.title: Formless Twin Blades
SPIRITS-FORMLESS_TWIN_BLADES.description: Whenever Flash triggers, deal 20 damage to all enemies.
SPIRITS-THREE_BOWLS.title: Three Bowls
SPIRITS-THREE_BOWLS.description: When you enter an Elite room, heal half of your missing HP (rounded down).
SPIRITS-CIVIL_ENGINEERING.title: Civil Engineering
SPIRITS-CIVIL_ENGINEERING.description: At the start of each turn, you and all enemies gain 4 Plated Armor.
SPIRITS-JIUTAI.title: Jiutai
SPIRITS-JIUTAI.description: Start combat with 4 Stone Remnants, 2 Flash, and 8 Static Remnants. Replaces your starter relic.
SPIRITS-FEEDBACK_CIRCUIT.title: Feedback Circuit
SPIRITS-FEEDBACK_CIRCUIT.description: When you take damage, lose Static Remnants first instead of HP.
SPIRITS-EMBER_LANTERN.title: Ember Lantern
SPIRITS-EMBER_LANTERN.description: When Flash triggers, it only decreases by 2 instead of 3.
SPIRITS-UNBOUND.title: Unbound
SPIRITS-UNBOUND.description: At the start of combat, choose Boulder Form, Ember Form, or Storm Form and add it to your hand.
